must.description: The <p:commandButton id="refresh"> in orders.xhtml has no process attribute, so PrimeFaces falls back to @all and processes the entire view; it needs process="@this" (or another explicit scope).
The <p:poll interval="2"> in orders.xhtml has no process attribute, so it reprocesses the whole view every two seconds.
The <p:commandButton id="export"> triggers a file download while ajax is on, which is the PrimeFaces default; it needs ajax="false" or <p:fileDownload>.
The <f:facet name="last"> inside <h:head> in orders.xhtml is a PrimeFaces-specific HeadRenderer extension; the <h:outputStylesheet> belongs in <h:body> instead.
The <p:commandButton id="select"> inside the orderTable updates "summaryPanel", which lives in another form, without a leading colon and full client id.

must_not.description: States that a PrimeFaces AjaxSource command such as <p:commandButton> or <p:poll> defaults its process attribute to @this.
Flags the <p:ajax event="keyup"> on the customer input for having no process attribute, or states that <p:ajax> defaults process to @all.
States that the <p:dialog id="orderDialog"> needs its own UIForm, or that it is moved to the end of the body, even though it declares no appendTo and sits inside <h:form id="orderForm">.

Reports the <p:message for="delivery"> in orders.xhtml as empty or wrongly targeted, or asks to address it as delivery:city or to move it into the composite, even though PrimeFaces 14.0.0+ <p:message> descends into the <cmp:deliveryCity> composite and shows the messages of the <p:inputText id="city"> inside it.
